title: Lawmakers Host Whistleblowers and UFO Investigators — Press Feds to Come Clean on Disclosure
detail: The Washington Times reported on May 29 that lawmakers hosted whistleblowers and UFO investigators on Capitol Hill to press the federal government on extraterrestrial-related disclosures. Representatives Burlison (R-MO), Luna (R-FL), Burchett (R-TN), and Moskowitz (D-FL) participated in the sessions. The meeting occurred one day after the announcement of the June 9 Capitol steps press conference, reinforcing a pattern of intensified legislative coordination on UAP transparency. Participants pressed for more substantive releases beyond the PURSUE program's rolling declassification schedule, including contextual analysis of the materials released — a demand echoed by six former officials in a DefenseScoop op-ed (May 14) who called PURSUE 'data release, not disclosure.' The sessions signal that congressional UAP advocates are escalating their institutional strategy, coordinating directly with whistleblowers and investigators to build a public accountability record. The next major institutional benchmark remains the EO 300-day full-disclosure-or-justify deadline in late Nov/Dec 2026, though the June 9 press conference represents the most immediate publicly scheduled pressure point.
